about_the_game:
RDL (Restoration Directive Labs) is a multiplayer (or single-subject) horror game set in a decaying research facility governed by AURORA, an AI created from the minds of the world’s top scientists. Once meant to restore the planet, AURORA’s conclusion was simple: remove human error.

You awaken deep underground, one of many cloned researchers known as RDLers.
Your task: gather artifacts, complete facility tasks, and appease the system that’s slowly losing its sanity.

Every run through the lab’s shifting floors reveals new rooms, new entities, and new ways to fail your directive.

⚙️ Core Features

🧭 Procedural Floors
No two expeditions are alike. Each level is built from randomized room modules.

👁️ AURORA, the Facility AI
Guides you. Judges you. Occasionally apologizes. Fully reactive to your progress and failure, and even what you whisper under your breath.

💀 Unique Entities
Each RDL specimen has its own behavior and detection logic, designed meticulously by AURORA.

🔬 Merge Machine Crafting
Combine recovered items to form unstable devices, tools, or living prototypes. Results may vary.

💬 Voice Interaction System
Use built-in proximity chat and experimental AI speech recognition to talk to AURORA. Understanding not guaranteed.

🧩 Solo or Co-op Research
Play alone for isolation-horror tension, or with up to 8 subjects for teamwork-driven chaos.

🧠 Persistent Progression
Unlock new facility logs over multiple runs. Each escape (or death) contributes to the greater understanding of the RDL facility.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Microphone Recommended

short_description: A cooperative sci-fi horror experience set in the underground facility known as RDL. Explore randomized floors, collect strange artifacts, and survive AURORA - the rogue AI overseeing your “rehabilitation.” Research continues whether you live or not.
